tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras las brtsams pa'i bka' lung gi dri ba'i bka' lan mtsho byung lus phra'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs// stobs dang mi 'jigs dran nyer thugs rje che// dpag yas yon tan rtse mor phyin gyur kyang*// thugs bskyed smon lam rjes dran sprul pa'i sku// rdo rje gsum mchog rtag par rgyal gyur cig /ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng phyug dpyod ldan kunaṃ dgaṃ'i phyir// bloṃ grosaṃ rnam gsal smra mchog nyin mor byed// rnam 'dren bstanaṃ pa'iṃ sbrang rtsi'i rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn tshal// rgya cher bzhad pa'i bka' drin bsams kyin dad// skyes sbyangs rtsal gyi byed pos legs phye ba'i// longs spyod 'khor lor dbyangs kyi rgyal mo yis// rnam par rtsen pa'i sbubs nas rgyud mangs kyi// glu dang bsres snyam bka' lung spyi bor son// chu skyes bsung gis nyer bskul bung ba'i bus// mkha' lding lam zhugs mgrin snyan bsgyur ba bzhin// bka' lung thos pas rab dga'i rmong rtul bdag /gang dran spyi brtol bskyed la spro ba brtas// gang blos dpyad pa'i g.yar lam chos kyi tshul// som nyi khengs pas bsgyings pa'i gnas med kyang*// mkhyen bzhin nyams sad tshul gyis 'dri bas kyang*// rjes 'jug dogs pa bsu 'di mkhas pa'i tshul// de'ang srid gsum gnas na sgrun zlas bden pa'i skyabs gcig dbang gi rgyal po nyid ni/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang de rnam 'dren mchog gi bstan pa bskyang pa'i phyir dang*/ sems can rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam dang 'bras bur smin par bya ba'i phyir/ lha rigs mchog gi dpag bsam dbang po'i skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rnam par rtsen pa'i rgyal ba gnyis par gyur pa gang gi legs gsungs tshangs dbyangs 'bum sde gcig tu bsres pa lta bu'i rgyud las/ gyi na pa kho bo cag thugs brtse gzhal du med pa'i gdugs dkar gyi grib bsil du chud pa'i brdar/

gang ci'i bka' lung zhib 'khod dang chabs cig rnam thos sras kyi sku brnyan bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i bka' lan tshangs sras rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i dbyangs chung zhes bya ba byas pa de nyid/ spyan lam du byung bar gzigs pas phab par brten/ deng 'dir stobs bcu mnga' ba mchog gi bstan pa'i snang byed chen por rnam par gdon mi za bar gyur pa nyid kyi phyir/ gang gis gzhal bya'i chos su snang ba thams cad/ mkhyen rab drang po'i srang gis ma bcal ba 'ga' yang med pa ni/ ji skad du/ mgon po byams pas/ rten dang brten pa bshad bya dang*// gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la// blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' bas// legs ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bsngags pa ltar/ phyi dang nang gi shes bya'i yul gyur mtha' dag so so'i mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid du bcas pa yang dag par mi mkhyen pa med cing*/ mkhyen pa de dag so so'i rjod byed sgra'i nges tshig mkhyen pa'i spobs pa yang dag pas 'chad par byed pa la chags thogs bral bar legs par 'doms pa'i dbang phyug gi go 'phang brnyes pa'i skyabs mchog dad sgrol chen po nyid nas/ mkhyen bzhin du gzhan gyi tshod bgam pa'am/ bstan pa'i byi dor gyi phyir dang*/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis dogs pa skye 'gyur gnad kyi sngun bsu bas 'dri ba'i tshul gnang ba ni yang dag mkhas pa rnams kyi tshul te/ de'ang 'di skad du bka' stsal te/ der rnam thos sras rta bdag brgyad kyi rten bzhengs las 'phros te/ rgyud rin chen 'byung ba sogs la dpyad pa rnam par dag pa 'di bzhin rgyal bstan spyi bye brag gi gsal byed ngo mtshar can zhig byung 'dug pas bka' drin shin tu che ba mchis/ bka' lung gis dri ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'on kyang rmor chen pa'i gsan yig na/ rtags med kyi gras la/ rnam sras kyi rgyud rin chen 'byung ba le'u bcu dgu pa kha che dgon pa ba dang*/ ye shes sdes bsgyur ba zhes lung gsan gras dang*/

brgyud pa 'dren pa'i skabs su/ dngos grub 'dod 'jo ma gtogs pa'i rtags med pa'i lung yongs rdzogs dang*/ dbang gi rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen gsan yig tu smos pa'i smad lugs dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan sogs las brgyud pa zhig 'khod 'dug pas/ 'di rgyud rnam dag min na/ brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnam dag yin pa gsan yig 'di sogs kyis bsgrub 'dug pa ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ zhes pa'i bka' lung rin chen dbang gi rgyal po lta bu spyi bor phebs ltar/ 'di dag gi skor sngar bka' lan tshangs sras rgyud mangs su de las gzhan pa'i shes byed dgod pa'i skabs su bris yod pa ltar lags shing*/ 'dir skabs su bab pa'i bka' lan 'bul ba la/ lung rgyun mtshan nyid pa yod med spyir dpyad pa dang*/ bye brag tu dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' dang rgyal sras rnams kyi bstan bcos kyi lung rgyun 'ga' rer sngar bla ma la lung brgyud bzhugs pa la dpe ma 'byor nas lus pa'i phyogs dang*/ la lar dpe rgyun bsgrigs rim rgyas bsdus mi 'dra ba cung zad re yod pa la'ang thos yig snga phyi dang dkar chag bsgrigs rim zhib dpyod nus mi nus kyi gang zag sna tshogs yod pas zhib tu dpyod dka' ba'i phyir the tshom cung zad re mi 'byung mi srid pa ni/ thams cad gzigs pa'i nyin mor byed pa shar ba'i g.yar lam du/ rmong rtul me khyer gyi sgron ma 'degs ma dgos pa dgongs pa rin po che'i mkha' dbyings su gsal ba ltar te/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig phan tshun zhu dag gi tshul gyis yid rton 'cha' bar byed pa tsam las dpyad dka' ba snang ba ni/ dus dang gnas skabs kyis bskal pas ring po'i lam du phyin pa'i phyir ro// 'ga' zhig rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ma 'ga' re gsar bcug lta bu 'ga' la 'jug mkhan dang 'jug dus snga phyi sogs nges pas de la brten nas lung 'tshol dgos mod/

de 'dra re re nas shin tu nges dka' ba snang ste/ dper na da lta'i sde dge'i par ma 'di'i nang la sogs pa bod yul phyogs kyi bka' thams cad kyi nang na/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gnyis med rnam rgyal bu ston gyis bsgyur ba na/ rgya dpe'i dbu nas yig sdeb gnyis tsam bsgyur rgyu ma rnyed lus pa dang*/ byang chub snying po'i rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs rkyang bod 'dir bzhugs yod kyang 'go'i gleng gzhi dang*/ mjug gi yi rang sogs yod pa'i rgya dpe ma 'byor ba la/ dus phyis sde dge bla ma phun tshogs bstan pa'i skabs su/ rgya nag gi yul du rgyal ba'i bka' lung khrod du rgya nag skad du bris nas yod pa/ rgya'i lo tsā ba bod kyi slob grwa'i mi bzang jing gir rigs las rim pa dang po'i tha'i ji mgon po skyabs zhes bya ba/ legs sbyar dang*/ bod dang rgya nag gi skad rigs gsum la byang ba zhig yod pa des/ bod skad du bsgyur nas/ sde dge bla ma phun tshogs bstan pa khrir bzhugs pa'i skabs der/ sde dge'i par mas mtshon pa'i bod kyi bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal thams cad kyi khrod du 'jug rgyu bskur byung bar lung rgyun med kyang da lta par ma'i khrod du bzhag nas/ mthar rgyu mtshan cung zad bcas bris yod kyang*/ de la rgyus med pa'am zhib dpyod mi nus pa rnams kyis/ rgyud gnyis med rnam rgyal dang*/ byang chub rgyan 'bum zhes pa'i thob yig tsam la brten nas/ gleng gzhi dang yi rang bcas stabs gcig tu bklag lung 'byung 'gro ba som nyi med pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ rnam thos sras kyi rgyud yin zer ba'i yon tan rin po che 'byung ba dang*/ rgyud rin chen 'byung ba zhes bya ba 'di dag ni/ bod yul 'dir sngon dus bstan pa dar rgyas che ba'i skabs su byon pa'i 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub dang lo tsā ba mang po'i spyan lam du ma babs pa'am/ babs kyang tshig don la dpyad rung ma byung bas btang snyoms su bor ba zhig min na/

sngon gyi dkar chag rnams su'ang med pa'i rgyus/ phyis su bu ston pa'i dkar chag dang chos 'byung rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag sogs su ma bzhag pa dang*/ kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyis rgyud 'bum kyi dkar chag bya rgyud spyi'i rnam gzhag dang gsan yig rnams su'ang ma bkod pa dang*/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung yig yan chad thams cad kyis lung gsan pa'i lo rgyus tsam med pa bcas/ tshar chen rin po che'i rjes tsam zhig nas/ 'gor rgya gar skad bris pa dang*/ mjug tu paṇ+ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba'i mtshan yod pa tsam la tho yor mir 'khrul ba bzhin du/ gzhung gi tshig don la dpyad pas ma zhugs kyang*/ dag snang rgya 'byams tshul gyis rnam thos sras kyi glegs bam khrod du bcug der bcug pa la phyi ma dag gis brtag dpyad ma thub bar/ ci mdzad rgyal ba'i mdzad par rtogs pa'i tshul gyis/ lung gi rgyun 'chad nyan byed pa dag gis kyang de ltar tshad mar bzung nas/ phyi ma phyi ma dag gis kyang de ltar bzung nas dpyad pas ma zhugs pa la lung brgyud zhar byung du dar rgyas byung ba la nges pa med dam snyam pa dang*/ gcig tu na bla ma slob ma dag snang can 'gas/ 'di dag 'dir tshud na bstan phan du 'gyur snyam nas bris pa yin nges pa'ang ma mchis te/ de lta min na bka' dang bstan bcos sogs 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung rgyun yongs su grags pa lta bu snyegs dgos pa'i phyir/ rgyud brdzus ma 'di dag la ni tshig don gang thad nas brtag dpyad cher ma dgos par rang mtshang rjen par ston pas na lung rgyun la yang de mtshungs zhig las ma 'das par mngon te/ mkhas pa ngag chos pa'i rnam thos sras kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyan phreng las kyang*/ bu ston rin po ches/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa 'di dang*/ rnam sras kyi rgyud sna tshogs dag pa dang*/ yon tan rin po che 'byung ba dang*/

bai shra ma ṇa kha rag khram thogs la sogs pa rgyud dngos ma yin/ phyag rdor sa 'og gi rgyud dngos ni/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis 'gyur mdzad pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa 'di yin par bzhed pas/ dpyod ldan kun gyis de ltar shes par bya/ kha rag khram thogs su grags pa 'di slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa lo paṇa tshad ldan gyis bsgyur 'dug pas rgyud dngos min kyang tshad mar byas na legs zhes bshad pas kyang lung rgyun mtshan nyid pa med par gsal lo// 'on kyang der yang kha rag khram thogs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad par gsungs pa 'di'i rgyu mtshan cis yin ma nges so// gcig tu na rnam thos sras kyi po tir chud pa 'di dag rgyud mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin pa dang lung rgyun yid ches yod pa bcas yin na/ brgyud pa gyes 'dzom gyi 'byung gnas smos pa dang bcas te bka' 'gyur ro cog gi khrod du lung brgyud yod par bcas bzhugs su btub mod de ltar ma byung bas kyang the tshom za zhing*/ dus phyis rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dang*/ rmor chen pa'i gsan yig tu'ang snga ma dag gis gsan yig tu brgyud pa drangs nas bzhag pa ltar/ mjug gi lo paṇa gyi mtshan yod pa rgyu mtshan tsam gyis/ rtags med dang dbang rtags yod pa gzhan rnams kyi zhar byung du brgyud pa drang rgyur byung song ba tsam du zad de/ 'di rigs la brtsad cing dri ba ma byung na tho yor mir snyam ngang du lus 'gro ba gor ma chag ste/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas legs par bshad pa las/ mkhas pa brtsad cing ma dris pa// de yi bar du gting mi dpog /rnga la dbyu gus ma bsnun pa// de srid gzhan dang khyad ci yod// ces gsungs pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// bka' lung gi dri ba gnyis pa ni/ sku nyid nas 'di skor la bu ston rin po che kho na tshad mar mdzad 'dug cing*/ bu ston gyis rnam sras bstod chen drag bskul skabs/ bstan pa'i dgra dpung gzhom pa'i phyir// lus la sra ba'i go cha gyon// lag tu rno ba'i mtshon cha thogs// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/

nyid kyis tshangs sras rgyud mangs der/ lha ma yin dang 'thab pa'i tshe go cha los yod// ces dang*/ rgyal chen sde bzhi sogs la go cha dgos tshul mdzad pa gnyis ni gros btab pa bzhin du gyur/ yang bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i bstod chen las/ 'khor gyi bstod pa rta bdag brgyad kyi bstod pa'i mtha' nas/ 'jam po 'khyil ba dung gi mdog /shes rab go chas gzhan 'joms shing*// rang bsrung gri phub g.yas pas 'dzin// dbang ldan gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad mi sdug brjid la rngams// sna tshogs rgyan can go cha bgos// zhes gsungs pas 'khor rta bdag brgyad la go cha yod par song bas/ 'khor la go cha yod pa 'di'i khungs ci yin nyid gzigs rgya che bas slar gsal yod pa zhu zhes bka' stsal bar/ bka' lan la gnyis te mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'di ni yi ge ma dag pa'i bris nor gyis bslad pa zhig nges par khas blangs dgos te/ gzhan du bu ston rin po che lta bu'i mkhas pa'i gsung las ma brtags pa'i bab col 'di rigs 'byung mi srid de/ bstan bcos ni dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin dgos pa'ang*/ slob dpon zla khol gyis/ gang phyir mkhas pa'i las gsum las// rtsod 'chad dag la ma nges pa// srid phyir mi 'khrul rtsom pa ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ cis phyir yi ge ma dag pa yin zhe na/ 'dir bstan du yod de/ de la gnyis/ mi 'thad par dgag pa/ 'thad pa'i tshul dgod pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ lung dang mi mthun par bstan pa/ rigs pas mi 'grub pa bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' gar mkhan mchog gi rtog pa sogs las go cha can du ma bstan pa ni bka' lan tshangs sras rgyud mangs dkyus su bris pa ltar dang*/ bstan bcos slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs kyi zhi ba bde byed kyi brtag par rnam thos sras gtso bo las 'khor rta bdag dngos su ma bstan na'ang*/

de'i ṭī ka las/ 'khor gyi rta bdag brgyad zhar byung gi tshul gyis bstan pa sogs las de ltar ma bshad pa'i tshul dang*/ lugs srol gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma nas brgyud pa'i rnam thos sras sprin gseb mar grags pa ser chen lha dgu la'ang bskyed chog rnams la'ang go khrab bstan pa med pa sogs rgyas par bka' lan gyi dkyus su 'khod pa ltar lags shing*/ bu ston rang gis mdzad pa'i rnam thos sras kyi mngon rtogs dgos 'dod 'byung ba las kyang*/ byang shar du 'jam po 'khyil pa dkar po gri phub bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams pa/ rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la chibs pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la mi sdug pa'i cha byad can du gyur/ ces dang*/ de'i skabs kyi 'khor rta bdag gi bstod pa dang*/ sprin gseb ma'i bstod pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa thams cad kyang zhus dag pher ba yod pa dag las kyang*/ 'di skad du/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni dkar// rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na// gri phub bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor// mdog mi sdug pa sna tshogs te// g.yon pa thams cad ne'u le la// g.yas pa mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// gzhan gyi dpung ni 'joms par byed// stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes mngon rtogs dang bstod pa gnyis las kyang go cha yod pa'i sgros ma byung bas yi ge phyi ma bstod ring gi 'khor bstod skabs der ma dag par ngos 'dzin dgos te/ de lta min na lugs 'di la 'phags bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan gang nas kyang ma bstan pa ma zad/ mkhas grub bu ston rang gis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs bstod par bcas pa'i nang du'ang ci yod ma dran par/ phyi ma rang dgar go khrab can du bris par khas len dgos pa'am/ bstan bcos snga ma'i tshig la phyi mas sun 'byin byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bsnyad du yod dgos pa'am/

khyad gzhi la gtan med pa'i khyad chos sgro btags byas pa zhig yin na yongs grags mkhas pa'i gsung du su zhig yid rton 'gyur snyam mo// gnyis pa ni/ rigs pas dpyad pas kyang mi 'grub ste/ cis phyir na/ shes rab go chas gzhan 'joms shing*// zhes pa'i don/ go cha yin na/ khrab rmog tshem tshem/ phub gang rung zhig las ma 'das shing*/ de ni dgra sdes tshur 'phangs pa'i mtshon cha rnams kyis gcod 'bigs byed pa'i nus pa 'gog pa'i ched du rang srung yin pas rang gi lus la bgo bar rigs mod/ de pha rol gyi dgra sde 'joms byed du bsams nas mtshon cha bzhin du bsnun pa'am 'phen par byed pa'i sems dang ldan pa su zhig yod de/ go chas gzhan la ji tsam bsnun yang dgra dpung gzhom bzod pa lta zhog mi gcig gi lus la rma khrag tsam yang 'byin pa'i nus pa yod pa mi sems na/ gzhan 'joms byed du ji ltar gdags su rung*/ der ma zad cis kyang de nyid go cha yin pa dpe rgyun dag pa gzhan la'ang yod do snyam na'ang mi 'thad de/ de rang gi lus srung ba'i thabs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ thabs sam byams pa dang snying rje lta bu la sbyar du rung mod kyi/ shes rab dang sbyar ba'i blun rtags 'dis kyang ma dag pa'i rang mtshang mngon sum du bstan te/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ byams pa'i go cha chas pa ste// snying rje yi ni ya lad bgos// zhes gsungs pa sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du/ rang srung gri phub g.yon pas 'dzin// zhes pa'i don yang phub kyis ni rang gi lus la dgra sdes brdeg pa'i mda'/ mdung*/ ral gri sogs mtshon cha 'ga' zhig gis gcod 'bigs mi nus pa'i srung bar 'gyur mod/ lag char bzung ba'i ral gri gcig pus ni/ khyi kha tsam bsrung rdzas su 'gyur na ma gtogs/ dgra dpung gis mtshon cha'i rigs kyis gnod pas mi tshugs par srung mi nus pa mngon sum nyid du grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ thams cad mi sdug brjid la rngam// sna tshogs rgyan can go cha bgos// zhes pa 'di'ang 'thad pa ma mngon te/

slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po rjes 'brad dang bcas pa'i 'phags bod yul gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi gzhung khungs thub gang nas kyang go khrab can du ma bshad pa'i phyir/ gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad la khrab rmog yod pa'i lugs srol byas pa 'di ni/ lugs gzhan gyi bstod par 'gyur gyi/ 'dir mi dgos te/ lugs 'di la khyad gzhi gtan med pa'i khyad chos go khrab bskon pas lhag par bzang du 'gro ba'am bskyed chog zab tu 'gro ba med pa'i phyir/ gcig tu lha ris pa phal gyis rgyal chen sde bzhi sogs kyi rigs 'gres bris pa'i lag rjes mched par dpyad pas ma zhugs pa'i ri bong chal sgrogs kyi rjes su snyegs pa zhig ste/ sa skya lo chen gyis/ gal te 'di 'dra'i chos log gis// sangs rgyas bstan la mi gnod na// mu stegs sogs kyi chos log kyang*// sangs rgyas bstan la ci ste gnod// chos log gzhan gyis gnod na ni// 'di dag gis kyang mi gnod dam// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gal te 'di ni bstod cing bsngags pa'i skabs yin pas go cha yod pa'i tshul gyis bstod pas snyan dngags kyi lugs la mi 'gal lo snyam na/ de la dngos po'i gnas lugs brjod pa dang*/ skyon yon la bsngags pa'i bstod smad bya ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ltar mi 'thad de/ 'gro bzang lugs kyi gnod sbyin rta bdag bcas la cha lugs de 'dra ma bshad pa'i dngos po'i gnas lugs ltar ma brjod pa'i skyon du 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ dngos po'i gnas lugs brjod pa'am// mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa na// gnas lugs ji bzhin ma yin par// bshad na mkhas rnams ga la dga'// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ phyi ma ltar na'ang mi 'thad de/ khyad gzhi gtan nas med pa la khyad chos kyi sgro 'dogs byar rung ba'i snyan dngags kyi gzhung de 'dra yod pa ma mthong ba'i phyir/ smyon tshig go /ma nges te bsnyon dor rgyan las de 'dra ba 'byung ngam snyam na/

de ni bsnyon yul yod pa zhig de las ches mchog tu bsngags pas mi mtshungs te/ rta bdag gi lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' lta bu la bsngags pa na/ dper na/ thags bzangs bsreg bcad mi nus lhab lhub gos// lha rdzas ma yin sra mkhregs rdo rje'i khrab// ces pa lta bur byas na btub kyang bstod pa 'di la ni mi 'tsham ste rang bzhin brjod pa'am dngos po'i gnas lugs brjod byar byas pa'i phyir/ bsnyon dor gyi dgos pa med do// gzhan du bsnyon dor byas kyang mi 'gal te/ dngos min pas go cha ma yin pa nyid grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang bstod pa 'di yi ge ma dag par khas ma blangs na/ bstod pa dngos la'ang skyon 'di yod de/ 'jam po 'khyil pa la/ go cha yod par byas pa dang*/ de'i rjes thogs su/ thams cad mi sdug brjid la rngam// sna tshogs rgyan can go cha bgos// zhes rta bdag brgyad la spyi khyab tu go cha bgo rgyur song bas/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍi li la khrab nyis sbags byas nas bskon pa'i rgyu mtshan bsnyad du yod dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'thad pa'i tshul dgod pa la dngos dang*/ dper brjod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ des na bstod pa dngos bu ston gyis mdzad pa gor ma chag na'ang*/ tshig 'di'i thad nas dang po'i rtsom gdan gyi yi ge de chad pa'am/ nyams nas ma mthong ba lta bu zhig byung bar/ de'i tshab tu mi shes shes rlom can gzhan zhig gis 'di 'dra zhig bcug na rung zhes gzu lums kyis bslad pa zhig ste/ de lta min na mkhas pa'i bstan bcos snga phyir 'gal zlar byas pa 'di 'dra 'byung mi rigs pa'i phyir/ 'o na bstod pa'i tshig de'i ma dag pa bor nas/ dag pa nyid du 'chos su rung ngam zhe na/ mi rung ba med de/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang*/ ji skad du/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pas 'di la'ang dpyad pas 'chos su btub pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/

de ltar na phyin chad dag pa nyid du ji ltar 'don snyam na/ dper brjod pas nges par bya ste/ shes rab go chas gzhan 'joms shing*// zhes pa'i tshab tu/ shes rab mtshon chas gzhan 'joms shing*// rang srung gri phub g.yas pas 'dzin// zhes g.yas pa'i lag cha gnyis ka'i chos sngon la btang nas/ chos can phyi nas brjod pa'i dbang du btang na de ltar rung zhing*/ yang na/ shes rab ral gris gzhan 'joms shing*// rang srung phub dag g.yas pas 'dzin// zhes so sor byas na de ltar du brjod pas kyang btub ste/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ byams pa'i go cha chas pa ste// snying rje yi ni ya lad bgos// shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs// zhes pa sogs dang yang mthun pa'i phyir/ sna tshogs rgyan can go cha bgos// zhes pa'i tshab tu'ang*/ sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan// zhes sam/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// zhes sam/ sna tshogs rgyan gyis sku la spras// rdzu 'phrul rtar chibs g.yon pa na// ne'u le bsnams zhes sogs dang sbrel te brjod na lugs 'di la 'thad par mngon no// zhes pa dang bcas te/ de dag gis ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ bla ma la ni bka' stsol zhu// bka' bzhin bgyi zhes brjod byas la// thal mo sbyar zhing ma yengs par// bla ma'i bka' bsgo mnyan par bya// zhes bshad pa ltar/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po nyid nas bka'i gnang ba nod pas nyes med du rlom nas/ spyi brtol bskyed kyin bka' lan du dbul byar sug bris su bgyis zin to// 'dir smras pa/ nyams 'gyur yan lag rdzogs pa gzhan gyis bsos// lang tsho rgyas pa'i glu bzhin ches snyan yang*// tshogs gsum lam nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu// ston phyir skyabs mchog dgyes pa'i bka' lung des// skye bar shes bya'i gzhung la ma brtags par// 'phyang mo nyug blor chags pa mkhas la med// gang phyir 'dri dang lan ldon thams cad la// 'dzum brgya dmul ba'i smra mkhas khyod gcig khums// kun gzigs g.yar lam dogs pa'i gnas bgro yi// blun khrod lan brgyar bzlas kyang lad mo med// dgag sgrub yang dag bzod pa lung rigs smrar// yod kyi gang dran smra ba'i shes rlom min// chu mang khur lci mkha' gling 'khun sgra la// dga' ba'i zlos gar mi bsgyur ma yū raḥ// lus rtsal rnam par nyams sam bro 'tshal gyis// nyen pa min na gyi nar ci ste sdod// zung gi bka' lan bsgrigs legs dri za'i glur// rnam par brtags pa'i yid 'phrog mtsho byung mas// rigs mthun khrod du glu len lhags so zhes// yig klog mkhas pa'i rig byed 'dun sar gleng*// dge bas 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul mchog gi sku// rab brling mgrin pa'i bkra shis chos dung las// legs bshad sgra dbyangs 'gag med ldir bzhin par// gsang gsum bskal pa'i yun du brtan par shog

/'di nas byang chub bar gyi bde dang dge'i// sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas khyod bstan 'dab stong tshal// bshad sgrub rkang drug bye ba'i mgrin snyan bcas// rnam rtsen phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor khyab gyur cig /ces khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po kun mkhyen bstan pa'i snang byed chen po dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ kho bor dogs slong ngam bstan pa'i byi dor dang rjes 'jug dogs pa skye 'gyur gnad kyi sngun bsu ba'i dgongs pas/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi gsung lan bris pa las brtsams te/ bka' lung gi dri ba zung dag gtsug tu babs pa'i bka' lan mtsho byung lus phra'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs rje'i grib mar ngal gso thob pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes pa'i bgrang gzhi'i zla tshes dge bar/ lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs ba gam gsum par bris nas phul ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༄༅// gsung lan dogs gnas 'bigs pa'i nyag phran zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// dge legs mtshan gyis legs spras dar babs sku// ma zlum 'char ka'i dkyil nas blangs 'dra nyid// dran pa tsam gyis blo mchog sbyin pa'i lha// 'jam dbyangs bla ma gnyis su min pas srungs// ngagaṃ dbaṃng gzhon nu'i byin rlabs ma zlum gyi// 'od rtses reg pas chos rab rnam 'byed pa'i// shesaṃ raṃb 'dab stong phyogs su rab grol bas// mkhas tshul gsum gyi ge sar 'bum dgod pa'i// bstan pa'i tshal mdzes bshes gnyen pad+ma dkar// shes bya'i yul la dogs pa dpyad 'os dag /khengs dregs 'dam du mi sbed bus par yang*// brtsad cing dri ba mkhas pa'i tshul yin phyir// gsung gis dris lan mdor bsdus mchid du bgro// de'ang rnam par dpyod ldan chos smra dam pa'i gsung gis legs sbyar gyi skad dzam+bu sogs ming 'ga' zhig sgra don gang yin zhes stsal bar/

gsung lan ni/ dzam+bu zhes pa sgra sgrub tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ dzan skye ba la'o zhes pa'i byings la na'i a rjes 'brel byas pa la/ krita kyi skabs nas 'byung ba'i rkyen buka byin/ ka ni/ ka la yan bzhin 'ong ste ya la brjod pa bor bas phyis/ na ni sde pa la de'i sde pa'i lnga pas mar bsgyur/ rnam dbye drug pa ngas byin/ de'i cho ga byas pas dzam+buḥzhes yod par tshig grogs dwī pa bzhag ste bsdu ba byas mthar si byin pa rnam bcad du song bas/ dzam+bu dwī paḥzhes 'gyur te/ gling 'di'i byang phyogs kyi mtsho ma dros pa dang nye ba na shing dzam+bu zhes bya ba yod pa de'i ming ste/ dzam+bu gling zhes pa'ang ljon pa de nyid kyis nye bar mtshon pa'i phyir/ dzam+bu'i rgyal mtshan can nam/ dzam+bu gling zhes bod pa'o// kā shi ka zhes pa ni/ kā sha gsal ba'i don can la/ i kaṇa gyi rkyen byin pas grub pa ste/ gsal ldan zhes grong khyer gsal ldan nas byung ba'i ras te/ kā shi ka'i ras phran zhig go /sha na'i gos zhes pa ni/ legs sbyar skad du/ sha na kaṃ zhes yod pa/ bod skad la'ang*/ de nyid sor bzhag sha na'i ras kyi gos te de nyid kyang*/ ras kyi rgyu las dras nas btags pa'i ming ngo*// pāñtsa li kā'am/ pañtsā li kā/ zhes pa ni/ lnga len yul byung zhes 'chi med mdzod las 'byung ba ltar te/ yul de nas 'byung ba'i ras so// go ta ma zhes pa ni/ rigs mchog ste/ rigs de las bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa'ang byon pas rigs kyi mtshan la go ta mar grags/ gzhan dag gis dge sbyong go ta ma zhes brjod pa'ang de'i don gyis so// gau ta mā zhes dbyangs ring po yod pa ni bu rgyud rkyen byin pa'i shul te/ rigs mchog gi bu/ zhes pa'i don te/ de la bod skad klog bde ba'i ched du/ go'u ta mā zhes sngon ma rnams kyis bris snang ngo*// yang dmag zor ma'i sngags kyi bklag lugs mi 'dra ba gnyis 'bod pa ji ltar yin zhes stsal bar/

gsung lan ni/ dmag zor ma'i sngags/ a bya ta bya/ zhes pa 'di la bod kyi 'jam klog ltar byas nas/ a bya ta bya zhes 'bod pa ni mi rigs te/ 'di rigs la sngags zur chag gi skad cung zad 'dres pa ma gtogs rgya gar gyi skad yin pas phal cher legs sbyar gyi lugs ltar bklag dgos te/ de'ang ya btags phal cher 'greng bu la// ya sgra cung zad ldan par bklag /ces pa ltar/ 'di la'ang dper na/ a 'be ya ta 'be ya/ zhes pa lta bur ya zar du chad pa ma yin pa/ dper na gdangs dbyangs mkhas pa rnams kyis ya dnga' rnams dngos su mi brjod par/ snga ma'i tshig gi rgyun ring du bsring ba'i ched 'don pa ltar/ 'dir yang yi ge gcig yun bklag pa'i zhar las thon pa zhig dgos so// yang lha mo'i sa bon bh+yo la 'byo zhes bklag pa 'di 'thad dam ma yin/ mgon po'i sa bon hūm̐ dang lha mo'i bh+yo rnams rang ming gi thog mtha' las btus sam zhes stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ lha mo'i bh+yo zhes pa la lo paṇa mkhas pas bod skad du bsgyur ba zhig de sngon ma nges kyang*/ bh+yo bzlog ces pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor gyi bzlog pa'i sngags su mang ba mchis/ legs sbyar dngos la bhoḥzhes pa 'bod pa'i skad dod la 'byung ba ltar na/ de 'dra zhig las 'phros nas/ las la bskul zhing 'bod pa'i brdar song ba yin nam snyam pa las nges pa ma rnyed/ bklag tshul gyi dbang du byas na bho zhes pa 'phags bod kyi skad kyi klog tshul gang dang yang mthun pa zhig ma byung yang*/ legs sbyar gyi bklag lugs ltar na yi ge gnyis ma yin par/ yi ge gcig nyid la bklag tshul gyis/ bho yo zhes pa lta bur brjod na 'thad par mngon te/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ gug skyed can zhig byung gyur na// phral re gug skyed kun la sbyar// dper na t+yu la tu yu dang*// ṣ+ṭhi la ṣi thri ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa sogs dang yang mthun pa'i phyir/ gur mgon gyi sa bon hūm̐ nyid ni/

skyed byed kyi sa bon dngos te/ rdo rje gur las/ hūm̐ gi yi ge las skyes pa// phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig ldan// zhes sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du lha mo'i bh+yo yang*/ rang ming gi thog mtha' gang yang min te/ de ni ma hā kā li de wī ste lha mo nag mo'am re ba tī ste/ nam gru ma zhes sam/ kā li ra tṛ ste dus mtshan ma rnams su 'gyur la/ snying po'i mthar hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes yod pa'i bh+yo 'di'ang skyed byed kyi sa bon nyid de/ shan pa nag po'i rgyud las/ rlung me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ thod pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du bong bu'i steng du/ zhing chen nyi ma dang bcas pa'i gdan bskyed nas/ de'i steng du bh+yo nag mo ni srog bsdu ba'o// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ yang lnga pa chen pos snyan ngag gi 'grel par tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ lhug pa dang*/ rgyun chags sogs kyi skabs/ sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa mi 'thad tshul dang*/ zur mkhar pa dang rin spungs sa spyod dbang po dang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags pa sogs kyis dgag sgrub mdzad par mi 'thad tshul 'dug pa don la zhugs sam ma yin zhes stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun por/ tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ tshig lhug pa dang*/ rgyun chags pa zhes bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis ston la/ rgyun chags pa de la'ang gnyis te/ rgyun chags bcad pa dang*/ ma bcad pa'o// de la rgyun chags bcad pa ni/ 'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i bye brag yin pas tshigs su bcad pa nyid kyi nang du bshad par bya'o// rgyun chags ma bcad pa ni/ sdeb sbyor gyi mtshan nyid lci yang la sogs pas phye ba la/ bya ba ston pa'i sgra yod pa/ rkang pa bzhir ma bcad pa ste/ de skad du'ang sdeb sbyor gyi tshom las/ rkang pa dag gis ma bcad pa// gang la yi ge sbrel legs yod// bya ba'i tshig gis gsal byas pa// de ni rgyun chags las gzhan min// zhes gdon pa'i phyir ro// zhes bshad pa ni/

rkang pas ma bcad pa'i rgyun chags yod pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi tshom zhes pa bod du ma 'gyur ba zhig yod pa la dgongs nas/ de'i dper brjod ni/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i rje btsun yab kyi bstod pa daṇ+ḍa ka ste/ bod skad du rgyun chags zhes pa nyid dper brjod mdzad de/ 'di lta bu'i sdeb sbyor ni/ deng sang rgya gar na sdeb sbyor ba ches che ba mang du thos pa 'ga' zhig la grags pa tsam du zad kyi/ thams cad la grags pa ma yin la/ sbyar ba'ang ches shin tu nyung bar snang ngo zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rkang bzhir bcad pa'i sdeb sbyor ni/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas la sogs pa dang mthun par tshigs su bcad pa'i nang du bshad par bya'o// ma bcad pa ni/ rgya gar du'ang mang du thos pa 'ga' zhig la grags kyi bod 'dir 'gyur ba'i rin chen 'byung gnas la sogs pa thams cad la ni med do// zhes bshad pa de la zhib par dpyad long ma byung ba lta bus rkang pas bcad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas dang*/ ma bcad pa'i sdeb sbyor kha 'phangs can gnyis/ rgya skad smra ba'i mi dang bod skad smra ba'i mi gnyis thod gtugs nas gtam smrar bcug pa ltar bsgrigs pas 'grigs par mi 'gyur ba gor ma chag snyam pa dang*/ der mngon pa kun btus las/ tshigs su bcad pa rkang pa gcig pa dang*/ gnyis pa nas drug pa'i bar gsungs pa dang*/ bram ze chu la ji tsam zhig /ces pa kun btus kyi dgongs don yin pas sdeb sbyor la 'jug pa mi rigs zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan yang brtag par bya'o// zhib par sngon gyi mkhas pa rin spungs sa spyod dbang po dang*/ ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyis mdzad pa'i gsung don la thugs dpyod gnang ba tsam las/ 'dir re zhig yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas de tsam zhig go /spyir yang sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis sngar bod du ma dar ba'i chos gsar du bsgyur ba la 'gyur bde ma bde cung zad byung ba la/

lo tsā ba phyi ma phyi mas 'gyur bcos mdzad du yod pa dang*/ ston pa'i gsung la'ang mi gsal ba rnams su gsal bar bya ba dang 'khrugs pa go rim du bsdeb byar 'byung ba sogs la dgongs nas/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang*/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pa'ang shes bya'i gnas kyi khyad par 'phral du mi rtogs shing ring du brtags shing dpyad pas go rtogs kyi blo gzhan skye 'gyur du yod pa ni/ shes bya zab cing mtha' klas zhes pa'i don la dgongs pas yin mod/ de ltar min pa brjod tshul dang go tshul gyi rig pa cung zad re skyes pa khong du chud dka' ba lta bu'i snyems pas yus de tsam du che ba la dpag na/ bod 'dir sngon dus mdo sngags skor gyi bka' dang bstan bcos kyi rigs phal che ba ma gtogs rig pa'i gnas bzo gso sgra snyan dngags sogs kyi gzhung bod du ma 'gyur ba'i tshe/ sa skya paṇa chen byon nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ga ta shrī sogs las brda sprod sogs kyi gsan sbyong mdzad nas mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod sogs las bod du mkho dgos gang che ba btus pa'i bstan bcos tshig gi gter dang*/ sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos dmar ser rin chen 'byung gnas sogs kyi dgongs pa mthun par me tog chun po dang*/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkho ba slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang chos kyi grags pa sogs dang*/ slob dpon dbyug pa can sogs kyi gzhung dang mthun par mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo dang*/ rig gter dang chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa la sogs pa'i bstan bcos brtsams pa sogs rig pa'i gnas lnga'i bstan pa'i sgo dang por 'byed par mdzad/ de nas brtsams te shong dpang la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis gzhung bsgyur ba la sogs pas bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad pa la nga rgyal dang yus ches sa gzhi rnam pa drug tu ma g.yos pa ngo mtshar re che snyam mo// yang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis snyan dngags skor gyi dri ba rang lan bcas la/

bod mkhas pas lan mdzad par yang lan 'dra yod dam/ bod mkhas pa'i gsung de tshad thub rang lags sam zhes stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ 'di la de sngon yang lan byas pa ma mthong zhing*/ 'di dag mkhas mnyam lung rigs kyi sgo nas brtsad cing dri ba'i tshul gyis gzhung don rnam par gsal bar mdzad pas na/ gcig blang bya dang cig shos dor byar mi 'dzin par/ gnyis ka'ang tshul 'dir bka' drin che mnyam du blta ste/ ji skad du/ mkhas pas brtsad cing ma dris pa// de yi bar du gting mi dpog /rnga la dbyu gus ma bsnun na// de srid gzhan dang khyad ci yod// ces gsungs pa ltar/ gzhung gis brtsad cing dri ba'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs par byed pa mkhas pa'i bya ba 'di las lhag pa bya rgyu med pa'i phyir/ yang mang thos klu sgrub pa'i rnam thar du sdom ro ma phul bar sdom pa gsar zhu mi rung ba'i lung du/ mdo rtsa bar/ blangs pa la slar blang ba med pa'i phyir ro// zhes dang*/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin can la bar chad ma dris pa yang ngo zhes pa'i lung gnyis snang ba mdo rtsa sde dge'i par ma 'dir med pa 'dra ba ci yin zhes pa ni/ 'di dag ni sngar zhus dag gi skabs su chos tshan che bas bka' bstan 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi gsan gang bzhugs dang tshar gnyis gsum bstun pa'i zhus dag bgyis pa las/ dpe tshan zur pa gzhan 'byor ma thub pas ci yin da ltar gsal bya ma mchis kyang slar lan gsal 'bul du yod pa byed/ sa paṇa gyi rnam thar mi nas mir gyur skye ba nyi shu lnga zhes pa dang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi skye ba bcu gsum bar ma chad pa ru zhes sogs kyi ngos 'dzin ji ltar lags stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ 'di rnams kyi ngos bzung gsal kha de sngon ma mthong zhing*/ paṇa chen rin po che'i skyes rabs su slob dpon ār+ya de wa la sogs pa'i skye ba bcu gnyis bcu gsum tsam bgrangs pa'i nang du'ang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bzhugs pa de ltar na de dag dang rgyud gcig par ngos 'dzin dgos mod/

de ni da lta de'i rnam thar du gsal yang de dag gis khungs gang la brten mchis brtsad dpyad 'tshal/ yang sa lugs sa rtsi khra bo mdzad pa nyang gi mthu bzlog yin gleng ba'i khungs gsal po yod dam gsungs par/ gsung lan ni/ de bzhin du bshad pa ma thos mod/ thos par gyur kyang don chung 'brel med zhig las ma 'das te/ rnam par brtags na rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras khu dbon rnams zab chos gdams pa'i rgya mtshor dbang 'byor zhing srung bzlog bsad mnan gyi man ngag myong grub thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa'i phyir/ sa rtsi'i kha dog tsam la dpung grogs g.yar mi dgos pa gdon mi za ba nyid de/ sngon gyi dus su sngags nag bon nag gis mtshon pa'i mthu chen mang po'i ngan sngags kyis ma tshugs par byad ma rang gshed phab pa'i lo rgyus sogs kyis gsal nus pa'i phyir/ 'o na gang gi phyir yin zhe na/ sngon sa skya pa'i yab mes kyi thugs dam gyi gtso bo rdo rje phur pa nyid mdzad pa lha de'i zhal gsum gyi kha dog mtshon pa'i phyir dang*/ nang du rtsa kun 'dar ro rkyang gsum mtshon pa'i brdar g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing gi kha dog can du byas par bzhed pa 'di nyid 'thad par mngon te/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i dngos slob mkhas pa'i dbang po shar dgas po paṇ+ḍi ta rje btsun phrin las 'jigs bral gsung rab gter mdzod sbas pa'i sde phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa'i gnas bstod las/ lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal// rtsa gsum dag pa'i kha dog mtshon pa'i mdangs// zla shel pad+ma rā ga'i phra tshom can// in+d+ra nī la'i sgrom bu spungs pa bzhin// zhes bsngags pa'i don la snyegs pa'i phyir/ yang chos sde 'di la ngor du 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan gang lags zhes stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ ngor zhes pa chos sde 'di nyid ma btab pa'i gong rol nas lung pa de la ngor zhes 'dod rgyal gyi ming du grags pa tsam las rgyu mtshan bsnyad du med par/

phyis su rdo rje 'chang gi 'od gsal klong du shar ba re zhig sa rgyus ma rnyed par/ slar yang khyod kyi dgon pa don grub kyis ston pa yod ces byung bar brten rim gyi sa brtsad chod de/ der chos sde btab nas e waṃ chos ldan zhes mtshan du gsol ba'i dge mtshan sogs thugs la gsal ltar lags/ yang bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar 'degs skabs/ shel gyi dra sgong du bcug la sogs kyi don ji ltar bgyi stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ der sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkhar bteg cing*/ shel gyi dra sgong du bcug nas/ ye shes lnga'i rgyas gdab bo// zhes pa bla ma bsam gtan 'od zer gyi man ngag go zhes 'byung ba 'di bzhin yin zhes bshad pa ma thos shing bris pa ma mthong yang*/ go don shar ba ltar na gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog cing*/ oṃ badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha zhes brjod pas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkhar bteg de'i phyi rol du shel gyi dra sgong ste/ drwa ba ni snod dam khang pa la'ang dra sgo zhes brjod pa ltar dang*/ sgong zhes pa ni de'i dbyibs sgo nga lta bu ste steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas zlum por yod pa'i 'od dkar po'i gur khang gis bskor ba de'i nang du rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gsal bar chud par dmigs la/ de nyid brtan byed du ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la ma bstim gyi bar du rgyas btab ste bzhag pa'i don dang*/ sang dngos gzhi'i skabs rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed cing gsal btab/ go bgos/ nam mkha'i dra sgong la hūm̐ zhes brjod pas yol ba bsal ba ltar phye bar dmigs te/ dkyil 'khor gsal bar mthong ba la sum bha nis bgegs bskrad de/ mchod bstod bstim pa sogs dkyus ltar byas pas 'thus par sems so// yang dbang chu mdzes rgyan nas bshad pa'i dgug gzhug gi phyag rgyar/

zhags pa dang dril bu'i phyag rgyar khu tshur dang mkhrig ma bsnol bar/ lag pa steng 'og gi khyad par yod dam zhes stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ zhags pa'i phyag rgyar steng 'og mtha' gcig tu ma nges par phyag srol sna tshogs mchis mod/ rnam par dpyad na g.yas pa g.yon pa'i steng du 'byung ba'i tshul du bzhag par mdzad pa nyid 'thad par sems te/ gzhan gyis rigs 'gre sbyar na'ang kun rig gi skabs nas hūm̐ badz+ra pa sha hrīḥzhes zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcing ba la'ang de ltar byed pa dang gzhan yang rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ 'byung po 'dul ba'i phyag rgya sogs la'ang g.yas pa nang ma'am steng mar bya ba'i tshul dang mthun pa'i phyir/ dril bu'i phyag rgya la 'ga' zhig gis ghasma ri la lag pa steng 'og gi khyad par gnyis ka 'byung ba 'di dag bdag mdun gyi khyad par yin te rang la bstim pa'i tshe phyag rgya kha phyir bstan tshul gyis dril bu nang dang rdo rjes phyi nas 'khyud pa lta bur 'byung ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi tshe phyag rgya phyir bstan gyi tshul gyis g.yon pa dril bu can gyi steng nas g.yas pa rdo rje can gyis mnan pa lta bur 'dod pa yod kyang de'ang rnam par brtags na mi rigs te/ 'di'i skabs su rdo rje 'dzin dgos pa'i shes byed gang nas kyang ma bstan pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya de bdag mdun gang yin gyi lha'i phyogs su bstan pa tsam gyis bstim byed kho nar mi 'gyur te/ dmigs par bla med kyi skabs 'dir rang gi snying ga nas gau rī sogs lha mo bzhi spros nas/ de dag gis bdag mdun gang yin la bstim pa'i dmigs pa byed dgos shing*/ phyag rgya ni de dag gi lag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang lcags sgrog dang dril bu yod pa rnams kyi dbyibs can bzo ba'i nyams lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ des na rang lugs ni/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur steng mar byas nas mkhrig ma bsnol ba'i tshe khu tshur g.yon pa steng g.yas pa 'og tu 'byung ba ltar bya ba'am g.yas g.yon go ldog pa ltar byas kyang mi 'thad pa med par sems te/

dang po ni dril bu ni rnam pa kun du g.yon pas 'khrol dgos pa dang de'i 'og tu g.yas pa'i khu tshur dril bu'i dod du byas pa lta bur 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ 'di'i skabs su ghasma rī g.yon pa'i dril bu gtso che ba las/ g.yas par rdo rje dgos par ma bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar min na g.yas pa rang bzhin gyis bsnol ba'i dgos pa bsnyad du yod dgos pas so// gnyis pa ni gal te sgo srung gi lha phal cher/ g.yas pas phyag mtshan 'dzin pa shas cher 'byung ba'i rigs pas/ dgug gzhug gi phyag rgya 'dir yang lag g.yas pa steng dang g.yon pa 'og tu 'byung ba ltar byas kyang mi rung ba med de/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur dril bu'i tshul dang g.yas pas steng nas bzung ba'i tshul du 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i don gyis kye rdo rje'i skabs kyi dgug gzhug gi phyag rgya 'di/ pha rgyud sogs phal cher la 'jug pa'ang rgyu mtshan des yin gyi/ gau rī sogs bzhi dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya yin na gzhan du ci'i phyir 'jug des na de dag bdag mdun gyi khyad par phyag rgya kha phar bstan tshur bstan gyi dbye ba mi dgos te/ dper na kun rig skabs kyi mchod pa nyer lnga'i rgyan gyi khyad par rnams mdun bskyed la 'bul ba yin na'ang*/ phyag rgya ni rang gi lus la brgyan pa'i tshul du byas pas dbul yul gyi gnas de dang der 'bul ba go ba'i brdar 'gyur ba lta bu'o// yang bris dang bskyed dang bdag nyid bsre sogs kyi grangs 'dren tshul/ bris pa bgrang ba dang*/ sta gon gyi dam ye so sor bgrangs pa ji ltar lags zhes stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ kye rdor mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul la/ bris dang bskyed dang bdag nyid bsre// mngal 'byin sta gon dam ye dang*// ye shes bsres pas lha 'dra yang*// rten la bdun bsres 'byung phyir rgyas// zhes pa ste/ rten gzhal yas khang la bdun bsres kyi grangs 'dren pa'i skabs/

bris pa bgrang ba ni/ ye shes kyi thig 'debs dang bcas pas bskyed rgyur 'byung ba dang*/ sta gon gyi gzhal yas khang la'ang dang por dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la'ang gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa spyan 'dren pas de gnyis sngon rjes kyi rim par so sor yod pa'i don gyis so sor bgrang ba yin no// yang kun rig gi srung 'khor skabs druṃ ban+dha haṃ la/ badz+ra sbyar nas 'don pa 'di dgos sam gsungs par/ gsung lan ni/ oṃ druṃ zhes sogs kyis shar bcing ba la/ druṃ ni sa bon no// ban+dha ni 'ching ba/ haṃ ni bsrung ba ste/ dpal mchog smad 'grel las/ yi ge haṃ gis chos kyi ngag rnams kyis shin tu bsrung bar 'gyur ro zhes pa tsam las/ druṃ gyi rjes su badz+ra sbyar ba ni dkyus su mi 'byung yang ngag 'don la mchis pa ltar rdo rje rin chen gyis kyang rdo rje 'ching ba zhes bshad snang ba tsam las rgyu mtshan gzhan ni ma mthong ngo*// yang gnas dgu'i ngos 'dzin dang*/ gnas nyer gnyis kyi bol dang long bu'i ngos 'dzin ji ltar byed ces stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ rdo rje rtse mor/ don kun rab tu sgrub byed pa'i// yid gnyis go cha bzang po yin// oṃ ṭuṃ go cha'o// zhes gsungs pa'i gnas dgu ni/ snying ga mgrin pa ltag pa dang*// snying ga nu ma'i bar dang ni// snying ga mgrin pa rgyab dbral ba// zhes pa ltar so sor bgrang na lnga las mi 'byung yang*/ mgrin pa lan gnyis dang*/ snying ga lan bzhi 'byung ba so sor bgrang na dgu 'byung ste/ nu ma'i bar yang snying ga las ma 'das pas snying gar btud mar lan gsum 'byung ba'i ngos 'dzin/ dang po g.yon/ gnyis pa g.yas/ gsum pa dbus yin zhes rdo rje rin chen gyis gsungs kyang*/ da ltar dang por dbus dang phyi ma gnyis g.yas g.yon byed pa khyad par che ba med dam snyam/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs/ rgyud las/ de nas byin rlabs byang chub smon lam btab// ces bstan pa'i gnas nyer gnyis ni/

snying ga lkog ma sogs nyer gnyis las/ bol ni/ rkang mgo gnyis kyi thog gi bol ldebs dang*/ long bu ni rkang pa'i 'gram g.yas g.yon gyi tshigs mtshams rus pa 'bur por yod pa la'o// yang bdag sgrub pa'i 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya'i gung mo'i bar du nas 'bru bzung ste/ 'khod ces pa dang dkyil 'khor la 'thor gyin snang ba 'di'i don ji ltar lags zhes stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ sbyong rgyud tshe dpag med nas/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra zhes pa nas ko3haṃ zhes nga rgyal bskyed la zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa'i don la/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis dkyil 'khor dmigs la bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes dang*/ phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra zhes pas sbyong rgyal dang bdag tha mi dad par bsam/ de bzhin du/ rat+na dha ra sogs kyis rigs gzhan bzhi dang bdag tha mi dad pa'i nga rgyal bzung*/ ta thā ga ta nas haṃ gi bar gyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad spro ba po gtso bo rnam snang dang bdag tha mi dad cing grogs gcig par bsams la sngags lan gsum brjod ces pa las/ phyag rgya'i gung mo'i bar du me tog bzung nas 'jug par ma gsungs mod/ sa phyogs gang du'ang lag len 'di 'dra zhig dar snang ba/ 'og dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'jug pa'i dus su/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong du mjal mi btub pa'i mtshon byed me tog bzung ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'ga' zhig gi sgo phye ba'i tshe/ me tog phul nas rang gi spyi bor bcing ba yod pa de/ 'dir yang dgos snyam nas kha cig gis rig bzor byas pa'i rjes su brtag dpyad ma zhugs par ri bong chal rgyug gi rjes 'brang zhig yin pa gor ma chag ste/ de cis phyir snyam na/ gal te 'dir rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas me tog bzung ba 'di dgos su bcug na/

dang por dkyil 'khor gyi khang par 'jug pa'i dus dang*/ bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i skabs nas/ thun mtshams phyi rol du spyod lam byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'jug pa'i dus sogs la'ang me tog re bzung dgos par 'gyur te/ de dag la khyad par med pa'i phyir/ 'di nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dgos pa ni/ rigs lnga po dang tha mi dad par bsams nas nga rgyal gzung ba'i phyir yin gyi/ phyag rten bsnams te lha ngo mjal du 'gro ba ma yin te/ dkyil 'khor mjal ba ni sngar 'jug pa'i skabs nas song zin pa'i phyir/ der ma zad mi 'thad pa gzhan yang 'di ltar snang ste/ lha mjal ba'i phyag rten lta bur gal te rmongs dad kyis 'bul ba'i dbang du btang na'ang 'bul tshul de 'dra byed pa blun rtags te/ dang por badz+ra dha ra sogs ma brjod pa'i gong der dbul dgos kyi/ dkyil 'khor las tshur bye ba'i tshe 'bul ba ni/ 'jig rten phal pa'i khams bzang gsol rten bzhag pa lta bu 'di rigs/ rgyud 'grel gang gi lugs la'ang bshad pa med pa'i phyir/ gal te mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len yin no zhe na/ lung rigs gang dang mi mthun pa'i brgyud pa'i phug de gang yin bsnyad dgos te/ chos rje sa lo chen pos/ gal te gdod nas med pa'i chos// glo bur byas pa yin na ni// kun gyis rang bzor go ba'i phyir// sangs rgyas pa'am mu stegs byed// su la 'dug kyang dor bya yin// zhes rgyu mtshan bsnyad du med na dor bya yin pa'i phyir/ yang 'jigs byed drug cu'i skabs las kyi gshin rje'i dbyangs la ya brgyad tshang ba zhes pa'i 'dren lugs dang*/ las gshin gyi bskul/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum zhes sogs kyi bskul 'di gang las byung zhes stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ las kyi gshin rje'i spyan 'dren 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol sogs kyi dbyangs la/ dang po'i 'go 'dren gyi ya gnyis/ de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyi thog ma bar mtha' gsum du ya re re ste ya drug bsdoms pa'i brgyad 'byung ba 'di ltar bgrang ba ste/

dbyangs yig las 'byung ba'i rol mo gcam byed kyi ya ni mi bgrang ngo*// de'ang spyan 'dren gyi tshig gi 'go 'dren sogs su ya 'byung ba ni gshin rje'i sa bon yin pa dang*/ mtshan gyi thog ma yin par bcas dbyangs kyi tshig ro gzhan dang ma 'dra bar ya sgra thon par byed kyang dgos ched kyis legs pa nyid de/ dper na lho phyogs rab gtum zhes pa'i bskul tshig la ya yig mang du byas pa dang 'dra bar snyam mo// las kyi gshin rje'i bskul pa rgya mtsho gting rum zhes pa 'di slob dpon mañdzu shrīs mdzad pa'i 'jig rten lha'i sgron ma'i mjug gi phrin las bcol bar/ rgya mtsho chen po'i sogs dang po'i tshig rkang gsum mi snang bas min pa/ mgon po ya ma rā dza ni/ sku mdog sngo nag 'bar ba la// zhes sogs dpe rgyun dang 'gyur khyad kyi tshig yar bzhag mar bzhag tsam min pa phal cher 'dra ba zhig byung bas de nyid gzhir bzhag nas bla ma phyi ma zhig gis byas pa 'dra snyam pa las sus mdzad nges pa de sngon rnyed ma byung ngo*// yang gur mgon gyi bskang gtor la chab rkyang pa las bdud rtsi mi bran pa'ang ji ltar zhes stsal bar/ gsung lan ni/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan rgyas pa gzhan ni ma mthong yang rnam par brtags na/ 'di sgrub tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ zhi ba'am rgyas pa nor sbyin ltar sgrub pa dang*/ drag po mthu ldan ltar sgrub pa gnyis las/ 'di nyid snga ma ltar dang*/ de la'ang thun mong du phyi sgrub gtso che ba'i lugs ltar byas nas/ mchod pa'ang phyi bya spyod sogs thun mong ba'i lugs kyi nyer spyod ltar mdzad pa dang*/ yo byad gzhan rnams kyang de mthun zhi drag thun mong du 'os pa'i yo byad ltar mdzad pa dang*/ gtor ma'ang*/ spyir sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ gsang sngags gsar mar gru gsum gyi// gtor ma gzhung nas bshad pa med// ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun par lha brgyad thun mong du dbul rung gi gtor ma dkar gtor zlum po ste/

lar yang gtor ma zlum gtor 'di bzos phyin sha khrag gis brgyan du rung ba lta zhog mtheb skyu'ang pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i rnam pa can kho nas bskor ba las gzhan bzo ba'i 'os med na'ang*/ deng sang phal cher mtheb mdzub gung mo gsum gyi rjes la kha mig sna gsum rnam par dod pa zhig bzo nas kha gso ba mthong ste/ 'di ni shin tu mi rung bar sems te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni gtor ma gru gsum can gyi chas yin te/ ji skad du/ mtheb skyu mgo bo'i thod pas bskor// chang sogs bdud rtsis de bkang la// zhes bkag pa dang mthun pa'i phyir/ bye brag tu 'di'i bskang gtor ni/ dzam gtor gyi dbyibs can bzo ba dang*/ bran pa'i tshe yang chu gtsang kho na las/ kha na ma tho'i rdzas chang rgod kyis mi bran pa dang*/ spyi mchod kyi skabs 'dir nang mchod thun mong ma yin pas bran pa'i skabs kyang ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa na'ang rgyud sde gong 'og thun mong du spyi 'gror rung ba sngags drug phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad pa las/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag gi rnam pa can gyi yo byad sogs su byin gyis brlab pa mi mdzad cing*/ mchod gtor 'bul na'ang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mchod pa rnams kyang ma 'dres par so sor ris su bcad nas 'bul bar mdzad kyi/ 'bras nyungs ma sgog pa rnams gcig tu bsres nas za ba lta bur ma mdzad pa'i phyir ro// des na 'dir nang mchod sogs gzhan 'gog pa'i dka' thub lta bu'ang ma yin te/ 'bul ba na/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i rdzas// zhes sogs kyis nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang*/ lcags kyu lnga sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod pa rnams kyang ris su bcad nas 'bul ba'i phyir/ 'o na dngos su bsham dgos sam ma yin zhe na/ sha la sogs pa rje rdo rje 'chang gis slob ma spring ba sogs nas bshad pa lta bu'i kha na ma tho ba med pa'i rdzas 'byor dka' ba ma gtogs/

'byor na 'gog pa min te kha zas bzang dgus rab bkang ste/ zhes sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ des na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi bzhed pa ni/ phra zhing phra ba nas mdo rgyud nas bstan pa tshul bzhin bsgrub pa las tshab bo sogs ci byung gang byung gis chog par mi mdzad pa ni rgyal tshab mkhas pa chen po'i spyod pa bla na med pa nyid do// yang ngor lugs bkra shis rgyas pa'i sh+lau ka re re la 'di 'di las byung gi mchan bu dgos zhes gsungs pa ni/ da lan rnam g.yeng gzhan gyi dbang gis long skabs ma byung bar slad du bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa nyid du mchan bur btab nas dbul bar bgyi'o// de dag gis mkhyen dpyod rmad byung rnam 'dren dam pa'i gsung lan mdor bsdus re zhig bris zin to// 'dir smras pa/ skyes sbyangs stobs kyi byed pos mkhas pa'i las// rnam gsum smra la ngaṃg gi dbaṃng bskur bas// lung rtogs chos kyi rgyal thabs skyong brtson pa'i// shesaṃ raṃb snying rje'i 'khor lo sngon 'gro bas// lho phyogs nags tshal bskyod pa'i dri gzhon gyis// bgrod pas dub pa'i don mthun bde ster bzhin// gzhan phan lhag bsam kun bslangs dri tshig gis// gsung snyan gzhon nu snying la bde bar sim// gang tshe dga' ba'i rtsal rdzogs ra ma ṇas// lung rigs mda' gzhu zung 'jug legs bshad mtshon// dka' gnas 'bem la bsnun pa'i ngo mtshar la// dpyod pa'i mig ldan dgyes pa'i ltad mor rtsen// sems can bde rgyur smin pa dge ba 'di'i// sgrun zla kho bor yod snyam sman gyi nags// kun nas rgyags pa spongs shig byang chub spyod// slob brtson kun gyi rgyud la de yod phyir// rgyal ba rgyal tshab bcas pa'i lung rtogs bstan// dpyad gsum rnam dag de 'dzin tshogs dang bcas// li khri'i phung po sa stengs yongs bkram par// nyi gzhon 'od kyis khyab bzhin mdzes phyir bsngo// zhes mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyi nor bus thugs rgyud gtams pa'i smra ba'i dbang phyug zhal dkar ngag dbang shes rab pa'i gsung mchid pad+ma'i tshal gyi dri bsung mngar pos yid kyi bung ba gzhon nu bskul ba'i gsung lan dogs gnas 'bigs pa'i nyag phran zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po rgyal tshab tu bcas pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes bya'i gnam lor/ dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs ba gam gsum par bris nas phul ba dge legs thams cad rgyas par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// rag nyag sprul pa'i sku mchog skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa'i bka' lan mi 'gyur phreng ba'i gad mo zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rnam 'dren yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mtsho// 'gror phan snying stobs ri bos bsrubs pa'i bcud// rgyal sras spyod pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od zer can// thub bstan bde 'byung ral par brtan gyur cig /ma drug brten pa'i skye ba blangs pa med// lha lus chos 'dul brtul zhugs ma bsgribs pa'i// brda sprod gzhung la gdong drug lhar snyems pa'i// lnga rig smra ba'i 'dren mchog zhabs pad+mor// dag byed khur ldan mkha' glang 'khun sgra can// mthong ba'i mdongs mtha' zlos pa'i gar bsgyur bzhin// dri tshig legs bshad kyis bskul spro ba'i mgrin// phyogs der bteg la spro ba ma bskyungs mod// deng skabs bya spyod nyung ngu'i rnam g.yengs kyang*// 'dzad med chu gter thigs pa kun bzod ma'i// rdul phran rjes 'gro blo chung chos yin phyir// spros min lan bu tshogs gsum phreng ba bstar// de'ang skyes sbyangs rtsal gyi byed pos lan brgyar phyis pa'i mkhyen dpyod shel gyi bzhin snod rang dbang du thogs pa'i mchog gi sprul sku zhwa ser cod paṇa 'chang gi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes chen skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa'i mtshan gyi gling bu rna ba'i dpyid du 'jo ba nyid nas brda sprod rig pa'i skabs kyi dri tshig nyung shas kyi glegs bu 'byor bar 'di skad du/ byings ming du bsgrub pa'i mngon brjod sngar gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa las/

de ltar gsar bskrun byed srol yod dam med ces phebs par/ lan du/ sngon dus 'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas pa 'chi med seng ge sogs kyis mdzad pa'i ming gi mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod rtsa 'grel dang mu tig phreng ba la sogs pa dang*/ bod yul 'dir de dag gi dgongs don bod du mkho cher btus pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i tshig gi gter sogs mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa rgyas don bsdus pa'i tshul gyis go bder sbyar ba mang du mchis pa rnams kyang gtso cher rgya gzhung dang mthun pa nyid tshad mar gzung dgos pa'i phyir gsar bskrun 'os pa ma mngon te/ dper na nam mkha'i ming la/ d+yauḥ lhas rtsen dang rol gnas/ a bh+raṃ/ 'gro med/ byo ma/ kun khyab/ a nan+taṃ/ mtha' med/ puṣ+ka raṃ/ rgyas byed/ na bhaḥ mkha'/ ga ga na/ kun 'gro/ khaṃ/ gnam/ su ra b.rat+tamā/ lha lam/ bi ya tra/ mi g.yo/ ā ka sha kun gsal te de dag ma 'dom na nam mkha' zhes pa 'gyur ba ste/ 'on kyang lha lam dang rlung lam zhes pa las 'phros nas/ legs bris lam/ tshogs bzang lam/ yid bzang lam/ 'chi med lam/ skyo med lam/ me zhal lam/ gnyid bral lam zhes pa lta bu gzhan la'ang des rigs 'gre byas pa'i mngon brjod kyi gzhung gis dngos su ma zin yang*/ brjod tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba 'byung ba rnams ni 'gal ba med de/ rgyu mtshan bsnyad du yod pa'i don gyis byas pa ni mkhas pa rnams kyis legs bshad dag las mang du 'byung ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du nyi ma'i ming la'ang*/ sū raḥ nyi ma/ sūr+ya/ 'od 'gyed/ ra biḥ grags ldan/ de bā ka ra/ nyin byed/ ar+ya mn/ sten byed/ ā di t+yaḥ mi sbyin skyes/ a haska raḥ snang byed/ bhāska raḥ 'od byed/ bi bhā ka raḥ rnam gsal byed/ brad+dh+naḥ rab rib 'joms/ sap+ta shwaḥ rta bdun pa/ ha ri da shwaḥ rta ljang can/ uṣ+ṇa rasmi/ tsha zer can/ zhes pa lta bu so sor yod kyang*/ ma 'dom na thams cad du nyi mar 'gyur ba sogs yod de gzhung de dag la legs par dpyad pas khyab bo// yang da lta skad shan sbyar byas pa phal cher rnam dbye dgos sar ma byin par sdeb sbyor dang 'grigs ched kho nas byas pa mang tsam snang ba/

sgra gzhung gi dgongs par tshig sdud kyi skabs su 'gro min dang*/ sgra mdo dbyangs can mar/ sdeb sbyor las ni si sogs thams cad du'o// zhes pa'i dgongs pa ltar/ ka lā pa'i skabs su'ang sdeb sbyor dgos ched kyis gcig tshig dgos par mang tshig dang*/ mang tshig dgos par gcig tshig byin chog min dang*/ tshigs bcad gcig skad shan sbyar na rnam dbye ma byin par sdeb sbyor bsgrigs thub byung tshe de'i skyes bu'am/ zlas dbye lta bu'i ngos 'dzin chog min phebs par/ lan du skad shan sbyar gyi tshigs su bcad pa la sdeb sbyor 'grigs pa dang*/ rnam dbye so sor ma nor bar sbyin dgos te/ de ltar min na/ ming kho na las/ tshig tu'ang mi 'grub cing bya byed las gsum sbyor du med de/ dper na/ sangs rgyas la bdag gis phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa la/ sangs rgyas/ bdag phyag 'tshal/ skyabs/ zhes pa lta bu zhig las mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ de bsdu ba nyid du'ang mi 'gyur te/ tshig tu mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ des na sgra gzhung gis bstan pa'i dgos pa yin pas/ bya byed las gsum ston pa'i rnam dbye nges par 'gro dgos snyam ste/ dper na/ ye dharmā he tu sogs rten 'brel snying po'i legs sbyar la sogs pa lta bu'o// 'on kyang rnam dbye drug pa'i gcig tshig ngas s+ya ru bsgyur ba 'di rgya gzhung rnams na dkon tsam las mi 'byung yang*/ 'ga' zhig tu gcig tshig ma byin par/ gong du brjod byar 'gro ba'i don zhes pa lta bu bod skad la yod kyang don la 'gro ba mang po yod pa'i don gyis drug pa'i mang tshig byin pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgya gzhung rnams las/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha te bh+yaḥ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ bha ga wad+bh+yaḥ zhes pa ste/ de'ang na maḥ swasti/ swā hā/ sa dha/ a lam/ ba ṣa ṭa sbyor ba la bzhi pa'o zhes 'byung ba ltar mang po'i don la bzhi pa'i mang tshig lan mang du sbyar ba lta bu rnams dgos ched khyad par can yin pa dang*/

gzhan yang seng ge'i gdan gyi skad dod sidhā sa na lta bu dbyangs gsal gyi mtshams sbyor ba rnams la rnam dbye mi dgos par byas pa 'ga' re mthong zhing*/ yang sangs rgyas spyan gyis gzigs nas lta bu la ni/ rgya skad la de nyid dngos las mi dgos kyang*/ bod la go bde ba dang brjod bde ba'i dbang gis/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs nas zhes pa lta bu bod skad du bsgyur ba rnams go bder bsnan pa tsam du zad do// rnam dbye med pa'i ming kho na bsgrigs pa ni/ skyes bu'i bsdu ba'am zlas dbyer yang mi 'gyur te/ legs sbyar gyi skad la bsdu ba byas na/ bod skad la'ang bsdu ba byas pa 'ong dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ sangs rgyas bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro// zhes sam/ bdag cag sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// zhes pa lta bu yod dgos pa'i phyir/ dbyangs can sgra mdo las/ sdeb sbyor las ni si sogs thams cad du'o zhes pa lta bu sdeb sbyor gtso che ba'i dbang gis gcig tshig mang tshig bsnol ba'i tshul can du 'gyur ba rnams ni/ dgos ched dbang gis byas pa ste/ dbyangs can sgra mdor ma zad ka tsan thams cad la'ang de ltar du 'jug go /'on kyang de dag rang dgar ma yin pa dang tshig don log par mi 'gro zhing brjod legs pa snyan dngags kyi skyon dang mi 'gal ba zhig dgos te/ dpal ldan daṇ+ḍīs/ ma ning 'di 'gro bud med bzhin// bud med 'di smra skyes pa bzhin// bdag gi grogs 'di srog rnams bzhin// rig pa rnams bsgrubs nor bzhin no// sa gzhi skyong ba khyod bzhin du// lha yi rgyal po rnam par mdzes// tsha zer can gyi nus pa la// mi bdag gzi yis 'gong bar nus// zhes pa de lta bu la sogs pa tshig don 'brel chags shing rtags rnam dbye 'gal ba ltar snang yang mi 'gal ba dang*/ yang de nyid las/ ngang mo bzhin du zla ba dkar// mtsho rnams bzhin du mkha' dri med// khyi bzhin dpa' bo rje la gus// nyi ma bzhin du me khyer gsal// 'di 'dra spangs te mkhas rnams kyis// rgyu yang 'dir ni bsam par byos// zhes dper brjod pa lta bu dang*/

gzhan yang snyan dngags kyi skyon bcu sel ba'i skabs nas kyang 'byung ba ltar nges dgos par sems so// de dag gis ni gsung lan mdor bsdus bris zin to// smras pa/ gzhung lugs thos pa'i rna lung rnam par yangs// 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i gtam gyi 'bab stegs bde// sgra tshad dpyod pa'i 'dren byed dkyus ring ba// mchog gi sgyu 'phrul rtsen pa'i yid 'phrog bzhin// gang las byung ba'i bka' lan rgyas min gyi// rjod byed mi 'gyur phreng bltar gad mo'i sgra// thos tshe bem chos brag ca'i lad mo dag /tshig don snying pos dben phyir mkha' dbyings yal// tshul 'dir 'bad pa las skyes rnam dkar dge /'di nas mthar thug byang chub reg pa'i bar// dal 'byor rten ldan gtsug lag yongs rig nas// smra dbang chos kyi nyi ma 'gyur phyir bsngo// ces pa lnga rig smra ba'i dbang phyug rag nyag sprul pa'i sku mchog skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa'i bka' lan mi 'gyur phreng ba'i gad mo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ shākya'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris nas phul ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
